name: @flisk-sh/gel
description: GEL: twenty-eight CI guards for AI-written pull requests. Leaked keys, secrets behind public bundler prefixes, unpinned actions, open workflow tokens, workflow jobs with no timeout, CI installs that ignore the lockfile, dead links, PRs that say green while a check is red, edited migrations, breaking API changes, missing tests, missing decision records, missing community files, undeclared owner or status, uncovered dependency ecosystems, landing pages a stranger cannot understand in five seconds, repos with no north star metric, products whose what, who, why, how, where and when are not each backed by a fresh measured number, ICE tables whose arithmetic or order is wrong or whose high confidence cites no evidence, a measured click map where too many clicks hit something that does nothing, sites that advertise an MCP server but publish no card for it, pages whose main input is below the first phone screen, branches forked before the base changed its CI, build or scoring files, and workflows or rulesets that would stall a merge queue.

scripts.test: node bin/gel.mjs selftest && node bin/gel.mjs eval selftest && node bin/gel.mjs meta selftest && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
